definition: Time-domain analytic-signal wPLI: abs(mean(imag(z_left*conj(z_right)))) / mean(abs(imag(z_left*conj(z_right)))), over time within each independently bandpass-filtered 10-second window; non-debiased, no edge trimming
filter: Butterworth order 4 bandpass SOS, scipy sosfiltfilt default padding; scipy Hilbert
stop_rule: If mean repeated OOF AUC is below spectral control, stop without tuning. All five predeclared repeats are evaluation, not tuning.
